RBI data indicates gross inflows dropped to $5.9 billion, a 46.6% decrease from August, while total outflows rose to $10.8 billion. However, net FDI for the first half of the financial year remains 20% higher than the same period last year.

articles.headline: Jharkhand Assembly Passes Resolution Opposing Special Intensive Revision of Rolls
articles.summary: The Jharkhand Assembly passed a voice vote resolution opposing the ongoing Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls and demanding its halt. State Finance Minister Radha Krishna Kishore alleged that 16% of the electorate was left out of the draft roll. The resolution also sought the removal of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar to protect the Constitution.

articles.headline: Delhi to Operationalize 40 New Health Centres and Two Hospitals
articles.summary: Chief Minister Rekha Gupta announced that 40 Ayushman Arogya Mandirs will become operational next month, with two new hospitals in Siraspur and Hastsal expected to open in 2027. The Siraspur facility will provide 1,164 beds. The projects aim to strengthen primary healthcare and reduce patient loads on existing city hospitals. Maternal and child care facilities are also being expanded.

articles.headline: Delhi Government Plans Deposit Return Scheme for Plastic and Tobacco Packaging
articles.summary: Environment Minister Manjinder Singh Sirsa announced plans to bring 'sin goods' under a deposit return scheme. The proposal targets plastic PET bottles and packaging for tobacco products like khaini and gutkha to prevent environmental harm. The scheme aims to ensure that recyclable waste is managed effectively through financial incentives for returns.

articles.headline: Auto and Taxi Unions Seek Fare Hike Amid Rising CNG Prices
articles.summary: Members of Delhi auto and taxi unions met CM Rekha Gupta to demand an increase in fares following rising CNG costs. The unions also requested a ban on private-registered motorcycles being used as illegal taxis. The CM reportedly assured the unions of government support in addressing their concerns regarding operational costs and competition.

articles.headline: Delhi Congress Demands Extension for SIR Electoral Roll Applications
articles.summary: Delhi Congress chief Devender Yadav has urged the ECI to extend the November 30 deadline for excluded voters to seek re-inclusion in the rolls. The party requested a new deadline of December 15, claiming that 47.5 lakh voters were excluded during the SIR process. Only 2.81 lakh of 5.41 lakh inclusion applications have been disposed of so far.

articles.headline: Three Arrested After Alleged Gang Rape in East Delhi Cafe
articles.summary: The Delhi Commission for Women has sought a police report following the alleged gang rape of a 22-year-old woman at a Preet Vihar cafe. Three suspects, including two women, have been arrested, while three others remain at large. The victim alleged she was assaulted by male colleagues during a late-night gathering. A case has been registered under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita.

articles.headline: BJP Files Complaint Against Comedian Over Derogatory Chhath Puja Remarks
articles.summary: A Delhi BJP delegation filed a police complaint against stand-up comedian Yash Maheshwari for obscene remarks about Chhath Puja and Bihar's women. An FIR has also been registered in Patna under the Information Technology Act. Facing backlash, the comedian issued a public apology, stating he had no intention of hurting religious sentiments or cultural traditions.

articles.headline: Teenager Apprehended for Stabbing Schoolmate in Northeast Delhi
articles.summary: A 14-year-old Class 9 student was apprehended for allegedly stabbing a Class 10 schoolmate four times outside a government school in Khajuri Khas. The victim is reported to be in stable condition at GTB Hospital. Police recovered a button-actuated knife and stated the attack was likely a revenge plot following a personal altercation between the boys earlier.

articles.headline: PWD to Conduct Structural Audit of 17 Delhi Flyovers
articles.summary: The Public Works Department will conduct safety audits for 17 flyovers built in 2004, including those at Moti Bagh, Nehru Place, and Savitri Cinema. A consultant will be appointed to recommend repairs and rehabilitation. The move aims to ensure the long-term structural integrity of these aging infrastructures and the safety of commuters using them.

articles.headline: Thackeray Faction Warns Against Toppling Elected Governments Through Defection
articles.summary: In the Supreme Court, the Uddhav Thackeray-led Shiv Sena faction argued that shifting political allegiance under the guise of dissent should not be permitted. Senior advocate Kapil Sibal claimed the Maharashtra Speaker erred by treating legislative majority as proof of being the original party. He argued that allowing such moves enables the destabilization of elected governments.

articles.headline: Rajbanshi Language to Enter Constitution's Eighth Schedule: Suvendu Adhikari
articles.summary: West Bengal BJP leader Suvendu Adhikari announced that the Rajbanshi language will be included in the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution. Speaking in Cooch Behar, he stated the matter was discussed with Union Home Minister Amit Shah on November 19. The move aims to fulfill a long-standing political promise regarding the cultural aspirations and security of the Rajbanshi community.

articles.headline: Delhi High Court Refuses to Interfere in Kartarpur Corridor Suspension
articles.summary: The Delhi High Court declined to entertain a petition challenging the government's decision to suspend Kartarpur Sahib corridor services following the Pahalgam terror attack. The court noted that the suspension was a policy decision taken in the interest of citizen safety. The services were suspended starting May 7, 2025, in response to security concerns.

articles.headline: Kolkata Civic Body Row Erupts Over Installation of Savarkar's Portrait
articles.summary: The installation of a portrait of Hindutva ideologue Vinayak Damodar Savarkar at the Kolkata Municipal Corporation (KMC) has triggered political backlash from the TMC and Congress. Critics argue Savarkar has no historical link to the city's civic body. The BJP defended the move, placing it alongside other icons like Syama Prasad Mookerjee and Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.

articles.headline: Maharashtra Cabinet Approves Free Foodgrains for 42 Lakh Farmers
articles.summary: A Maharashtra Cabinet meeting chaired by CM Devendra Fadnavis approved providing 5kg of free foodgrains per month for three months to farmers in 33 drought-affected districts. The Cabinet also authorized ₹5,548 crore for the Narmada-Tapi diversion project and passed a bill to regulate private-aided schools. New measures were also introduced to confiscate assets of fraudulent firms.

articles.headline: PM Modi to Address Moga Rally After BJP-SAD Alliance Renewal
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is scheduled to address a National Democratic Alliance rally in Moga, Punjab, on December 8. The event follows the reconciliation between the BJP and the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD). The rally will mark the birth anniversary of Akali patriarch Parkash Singh Badal. SAD chief Sukhbir Singh Badal will also participate in the joint address.

articles.headline: Kerala Congress Intervenes to Settle Legacy Feud Between Senior Leaders
articles.summary: The Kerala Pradesh Congress Committee (KPCC) has stepped in to halt public infighting between MPs Shafi Parambil and Rajmohan Unnithan over Oommen Chandy's political legacy. Unnithan had accused Parambil of loyalty issues during the late CM's final years. The KPCC president has asked both leaders to stand down to prevent further reputational damage to the party.

articles.headline: Rajnath Singh Accuses Congress of Attempting to Destabilize Democracy
articles.summary: Defense Minister Rajnath Singh claimed the Congress is trying to undermine democratic institutions and the Election Commission in its pursuit of power. Speaking in Karnataka, he cited the 1975 Emergency and the 1984 violence as evidence of the party's record. He announced a nationwide 'Save Democracy' campaign to counter what he termed Congress-led anarchy.

articles.headline: Karnataka Approves First-of-its-Kind Burns Survivors Rehabilitation Policy
articles.summary: The Karnataka Cabinet has approved a comprehensive policy for the prevention, treatment, and social reintegration of burns survivors. The state will set up 15-bed specialized burns care wards in district hospitals and upgrade the Mahabodhi Burns Care Centre. The policy provides standardized protocols for emergency response and long-term surgical interventions.

articles.headline: BJD Opposes Cuttack Data Centre Over Water Scarcity Concerns
articles.summary: The Biju Janata Dal has objected to the Odisha government's approval of a ₹1.4 lakh crore Adani group data centre in Cuttack. The party claims the facility's daily requirement of three crore litres of water will cause acute shortages in Bhubaneswar, Cuttack, and Puri. BJD leaders urged the government to relocate the project to a remote area with less human habitation.

articles.headline: U.P. Chief Ministerial Candidate to be Decided After Polls: Maurya

He emphasized that the party is currently fighting under the 'lotus' symbol. Current CM Yogi Adityanath responded by saying everyone is contesting on the party symbol and that its success is the primary focus.

articles.summary: A report by IN-SPACe reveals that 60% of Indian satellite costs are linked to imported electronics and specialized materials. It highlights that the private sector is largely limited to structural assemblies. The report calls for strategic investments in R&D and testing facilities to transition India from a satellite assembler to a leading global exporter of space systems.

articles.headline: Sensex Gains 1,502 Points as Rupee Surges to Eight-Month High
articles.summary: Indian equity indices jumped 1.85% on Wednesday, with the Sensex closing at 83,938. The rally was driven by fresh buying in large-cap stocks like HUL and ICICI Bank. Concurrently, the Indian rupee rose to an eight-month high of 92.30 against the US dollar. Lower crude oil prices and a resilient domestic currency supported widespread investor optimism.

articles.summary: AI's rapid evolution and adoption are transforming business and society. It necessitates deeper engagement between businesses, government, and stakeholders, focusing on governance and ethics.

articles.headline: A test of India’s export ambitions
articles.summary: New EU regulations on sustainability, traceability, and human rights pose challenges for Indian exporters, requiring data collection and compliance, potentially affecting margins and market access.

articles.headline: US proposes 25% tariff on Indian goods, 17% with trade deal
articles.summary: The US has proposed a 25% tariff on various Indian imports, citing excess manufacturing capacity. However, a potential reciprocal trade deal could lower this rate to 17%. The proposal aims to address trade imbalances and target items like textiles, chemicals, and auto parts. India has expressed concerns over the move, noting its impact on 'Make in India' and local manufacturing incentives.

articles.headline: Supreme Court sets aside order for CBI probe into Rahul Gandhi's assets
articles.summary: The Supreme Court has overturned an Allahabad High Court order that directed the CBI and ED to investigate the assets of Congress leader Rahul Gandhi. The court questioned the maintainability of the original petition filed by a BJP worker. This decision provides significant legal relief to the Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha by halting the state-level investigative mandate.

articles.headline: Tata Sons adds six-month IPO timeline to upcoming board meeting agenda
articles.summary: Tata Sons has included a proposal for an Initial Public Offering (IPO) on its November 30 board meeting agenda. The plan suggests launching the IPO within six months. The move follows regulatory requirements by the RBI for 'upper-layer' non-banking financial companies to list on stock exchanges. The decision may impact the Shapoorji Pallonji Group, which holds an 18.4% stake in the firm.

articles.headline: Cabinet approves 11,000 crore scheme for construction equipment manufacturing
articles.summary: The Union Cabinet approved an ₹11,000 crore production-linked incentive scheme to boost domestic manufacturing of construction and infrastructure equipment. The scheme, running from FY27 to FY34, targets seven equipment categories and five component types to reduce import dependence. Currently, the Indian market for such machinery remains approximately 45% dependent on imports from overseas.

articles.headline: Gukesh and Sindarov Draw Quickly in Second World Championship Game
articles.summary: D. Gukesh and Javokhir Sindarov played out a 20-move draw in their second game of the World Chess Championship in Geneva. Gukesh, playing white, utilized the London System, but the position remained equal throughout. The title match is currently tied at 1-1. Unlike the first game, Wednesday's encounter was a quieter affair without significant time pressure for either player.

articles.headline: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy to step down in December
articles.summary: Kalyan Krishnamurthy is resigning as Flipkart CEO after 11 years, with his last day on 4 December. Balaji Thiagarajan will lead the firm alongside the board until a successor is named. The exit comes as IPO plans remain deferred by parent Walmart, which is focusing on Ebitda profitability first. Krishnamurthy was credited with scaling the firm and managing its transition after the 2018 buyout.

articles.headline: US jury finds Huawei guilty of criminal charges and trade secret theft
articles.summary: A federal jury in Brooklyn has found Chinese tech giant Huawei guilty of several criminal charges, including conspiracy to steal trade secrets from US competitors and defrauding banks. The verdict follows a long-running legal battle and adds to the tensions between the US and China over technology and national security. Huawei has denied the allegations and intends to appeal the decision.

articles.headline: Jensen Huang undergoes therapy post reinstatement as Nvidia CEO
articles.summary: Following a falling out over extramarital affairs and a toxic management style, Jensen Huang has been reinstated as Nvidia CEO with support from Donald Trump. Huang told employees he is undergoing daily therapy to become a 'better human being' and acknowledged violating the company's code of conduct. Meanwhile, Congressional scrutiny of Nvidia's China business continues to build.

articles.headline: New Delhi named host for 2028 Thomas and Uber Cup finals
articles.summary: New Delhi has been selected to host the 2028 Thomas and Uber Cup, marking the return of the prestigious badminton tournament to India. The Badminton World Federation made the announcement, highlighting India's successful track record in organizing international sporting events. The tournament is expected to feature top global talent and further boost the profile of the sport in the country.

articles.headline: Lajja Gauri idol to Tagore painting: Yuge Yugeen museum takes shape
articles.summary: Sections of Delhi's North Block are being converted into the Yuge Yugeen Bharat Museum, set to be the world's largest. The museum will showcase artifacts spanning 5,000 years of Indian history, including a Mauryan Lajja Gauri idol and Tagore paintings. The project involves extensive restoration of the colonial-era building to house over 1.8 million objects across eight themed galleries.

articles.headline: US Army blows up 4.4 tonnes of explosive in Iowa safety operation
articles.summary: The US Army safely detonated approximately 4.4 tonnes of degraded lead azide at the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant. The explosive, which had become unstable due to age and moisture, posed a significant risk of uncontrolled detonation. Residents within a 5-mile radius were advised to stay indoors during the operation, which successfully neutralized the country's largest stockpile of the chemical.

articles.headline: U.S. Unveils 25% Tariff on India Citing Harmful Trade Practices
articles.summary: The U.S. Trade Representative has announced a 25% tariff on Indian imports following a Section 301 investigation into alleged harmful trade acts. The tariff could drop to 17% if a reciprocal trade agreement is reached. India denies having structural excess capacity in any sector and is currently examining the notice. The U.S. also targeted China, the EU, and Vietnam in this move.

articles.headline: FIRs against 300 BJP workers over Madurai Deepam lamp row
articles.summary: Police registered four FIRs against 300 Hindu activists and BJP members, including former Union minister Pon Radhakrishnan, following protests in Thirupparankundram. The unrest began after the state government allegedly defied a Supreme Court order regarding the lighting of the traditional Karthigai Deepam lamp at an alternative hill location. Protesters were charged with disrupting traffic.

articles.headline: Lakshmi Venu moves Madras High Court over TVS family assets
articles.summary: Lakshmi Venu has filed a lawsuit against her father Venu Srinivasan to split the assets of the family branch of the TVS Group. The assets include three listed companies valued at ₹2.5 trillion. Venu claims the move follows failed efforts for an amicable dialogue. The dispute centres on the ownership of joint family assets rather than the day-to-day operations of the industrial conglomerate.

articles.headline: Samajwadi Party and Congress Clash Over Seat-Sharing in Uttar Pradesh
articles.summary: Tensions emerged between the Samajwadi Party and Congress after Akhilesh Yadav unilaterally declared candidates for five Assembly seats. Congress leaders expressed frustration, stating that seat-sharing negotiations were still ongoing. While the SP chief urged Congress to understand public realities, Congress officials asserted they are not begging for a respectable agreement.

articles.headline: Ministers told to avoid foreign travel for possible Parliament session
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has advised Cabinet ministers to avoid overseas engagements and remain prepared for a Parliament session likely to be convened by December 15. The government has not prorogued the monsoon session, allowing it to reconvene both Houses on short notice. Speculation suggests the session will introduce the delimitation bill and implement women’s reservation laws.

articles.headline: India and China hold high-level talks on border management
articles.summary: Indian and Chinese military officials held high-level talks in the Arunachal Pradesh sector to address border management and outstanding issues along the Line of Actual Control (LAC). The meeting comes amid reports of Chinese troop posturing in the Upper Subansiri region. Both sides discussed maintaining peace and stability along the frontier as part of ongoing diplomatic and military efforts.

articles.headline: Supreme Court Cancels Bail of Former Karnataka Minister Vinay Kulkarni
articles.summary: The Supreme Court has cancelled the bail and suspended life sentence of former Karnataka Minister Vinay Kulkarni in the murder case of BJP leader Yogesh Goudar. The court labeled the High Court's grant of bail as 'perverse' and ordered Kulkarni to surrender within two weeks. The bench stated that heinous crime convicts require compelling reasons for bail, which were absent.

articles.headline: Tamil Nadu Signs 78 Investment MoUs Worth Over ₹58,000 Crore
articles.summary: The Tamil Nadu government signed 78 MoUs totaling ₹58,214 crore at the VETTRI Investment Conclave. The projects, led by CM C. Joseph Vijay, have the potential to generate 65,786 jobs. The Chief Minister also laid foundation stones for 15 additional projects worth ₹7,925 crore. The state continues to focus on industrial conversion and large-scale employment generation.

articles.headline: Wipro secures 600 million dollar finance transformation deal from BP
articles.summary: Wipro has won a major contract from energy giant BP to transform its finance operations. The multi-year deal, estimated at $600 million, will see 3,000 BP employees in India, Hungary, and Malaysia transition to Wipro in 2027. Wipro will utilize its AI-first platform to simplify processes and improve efficiency, following other billion-dollar deals with Olam and Phoenix Group.

articles.headline: LG Electronics to offload 2 percent stake in Indian subsidiary
articles.summary: LG Electronics plans to sell up to 13.6 million shares (a 2% stake) in its Indian unit to comply with minimum public shareholding norms. The transaction, valued at approximately Rs 2,470 crore, will be conducted via open-market sales by December 31. This will reduce the South Korean parent's stake to 83% from the current 85%.

articles.headline: FSSAI widens packaged water probe after Bisleri sample fails test
articles.summary: The food regulator FSSAI is collecting packaged water samples nationwide for testing after a Bisleri sample failed lab checks. Lab results are expected within two months. CEO Rajit Punhani also announced upcoming inspections of packaging materials to ensure they are 'food grade.' FSSAI has sanctioned prosecution against Bisleri International as it ramps up its enforcement drive.

articles.headline: Rupee hits 8-month high as foreign investors pour into Indian stocks
articles.summary: The Indian rupee strengthened 72 paise to close at 92.23 against the US dollar, wiping out its current financial year losses. The gain was supported by lower crude oil prices and record foreign portfolio inflows of $14.3 billion into Indian equities this November. The RBI was a net seller of dollars in September to manage the currency's sharp appreciation.

articles.headline: PhonePe restarts IPO process targeting 15 billion dollar valuation
articles.summary: Walmart-backed PhonePe has resumed its IPO preparations, targeting a listing in early 2027 at a valuation between $12 billion and $15 billion. The company plans to file updated draft papers with Sebi within 45 days. PhonePe processes nearly half of India's UPI transactions and its debut is expected to be the largest fintech float since Paytm's listing in 2021.

articles.headline: Government approves six gas-based urea projects worth Rs 55,000 crore
articles.summary: The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs has approved six brownfield gas-based urea projects with a total investment of Rs 55,000 crore. The initiative aims to enhance domestic production and reduce dependency on imports. The projects are expected to add 7.62 million tonnes of annual production capacity, helping India move toward self-sufficiency.

articles.headline: Air India CEO targets 6,000 crore rupees in cost savings
articles.summary: Air India CEO Tewolde Gebremariam is targeting ₹6,000 crore in savings as part of a turnaround plan. The strategy involves bringing Air India and low-cost arm Air India Express closer by sharing support functions like finance, HR, and IT to cut duplication. The group has already identified ₹3,500 crore in opportunities. Regulatory and customer-facing roles will remain separate for both carriers.

articles.headline: Amazon says India cumulative exports touch $27 billion
articles.summary: E-commerce giant Amazon announced that cumulative exports from India through its Global Selling program have reached $27 billion. The number of Indian exporters on the platform has grown by 20% in the last year. Key growth sectors include home textiles, apparel, and toys, with significant contributions from sellers in clusters like Surat, Jaipur, and Ludhiana.

articles.headline: Meta executives meet Congress leaders amid content moderation protests
articles.summary: Top executives from Meta, the parent company of Facebook and Instagram, met with Indian National Congress leaders in New Delhi. The meeting follows protests by the party's youth wing over alleged content curbs and political bias in Meta's moderation algorithms. Both sides discussed concerns regarding freedom of speech and the fair application of community standards.

articles.headline: PM Modi Stresses Constitution’s Role in Social and Economic Justice
articles.summary: Marking Constitution Day, Prime Minister Narendra Modi highlighted the document's role in promoting justice and outlined government achievements through welfare schemes like Ayushman Bharat. He criticized past administrations for weakening fundamental freedoms through the 1951 First Amendment and the 42nd Amendment. He urged youth to study the history of constitutional leadership.

articles.headline: EC orders BLOs to rectify electoral roll discrepancies via Form 8
articles.summary: The Election Commission has directed Booth Level Officers (BLOs) in 24 states and UTs to verify mismatched entries in electoral rolls. The special intensive revision (SIR) exercise allows electors to rectify errors in names, dates of birth, and photographs using Form 8. The move follows concerns over automated identification errors during the ongoing special summary revision process.

articles.headline: Congress wins majority of zila pramukh posts in Rajasthan elections
articles.summary: In Rajasthan's indirect rural body elections, Congress secured 24 out of 37 zila pramukh posts, while the BJP won 10. The Bharat Adivasi Party and Rashtriya Loktantrik Party secured the remaining seats. Results showed significant cross-voting, notably in Churu where the BJP candidate won despite a Congress majority, and in Jaisalmer, where 21-year-old Santosh Kumari became the youngest pramukh.

articles.headline: BJP workers sentenced to life for 2016 CPM member murder
articles.summary: A Kerala court has sentenced three BJP-RSS workers to life imprisonment for the 2016 murder of CPM member C V Dhanaraj. Dhanaraj was hacked to death in front of his family in Payyannur. The court in Taliparamba delivered the judgment after finding the accused guilty of the political killing that occurred nearly a decade ago.

articles.headline: China Launches Crewed Spaceship Carrying First Pakistani Astronaut
articles.summary: China successfully launched the Shenzhou 24 spacecraft on Wednesday, carrying two Chinese astronauts and Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, the first Pakistani crew member to go to space. The mission is heading to the Tiangong space station. The launch marks a significant milestone in China-Pakistan space cooperation and the expansion of international participation in China's space program.

articles.headline: RBI shifts more gold reserves to India amid geopolitical risks
articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India now holds 84% of its gold reserves domestically, up from 77% six months ago. The central bank repatriated bullion from the Bank of England as global regulators reassess the risks of holding sovereign assets overseas. Gold accounts for 14% of India’s $705 billion total foreign exchange reserves, reflecting a strategy to safeguard assets amid global uncertainty.

articles.headline: Tata Steel evaluates restructuring deal with APL Apollo Tubes
articles.summary: Tata Steel is considering restructuring its ₹28,000 crore deal with APL Apollo Tubes due to investor concerns over the complex transaction and debt burden. APL Apollo was set to acquire two businesses from Tata Steel, while Tata Steel planned to buy a 26.38% promoter stake in APL Apollo. Shares of both companies fell sharply as minority shareholders raised objections over the deal's structure.

articles.headline: Water Conservation Efforts Intensified
articles.summary: Authorities have launched intensified water conservation efforts in response to diminishing groundwater levels. Public participation and efficient water management strategies are crucial for long-term sustainability.

articles.headline: Vi lets go of 4.4 MHz spectrum in Mumbai, seeks extension in 8 circles
articles.summary: Vodafone Idea (Vi) will not renew 4.4 MHz spectrum in Mumbai but seeks extension for 39.6 MHz in eight circles as licenses expire Dec 4. The move is based on business needs, aiming to avoid service disruption.

articles.headline: Only 2% factories have R&D units; 4 sectors employ 2/3rds research staff
articles.summary: Just 1.9% of India's factories have R&D units, employing 0.3% of the workforce. Pharmaceuticals, chemicals, machinery, and motor vehicles lead R&D staff concentration.

articles.headline: RBI raises caution as NBFCs’ bank borrowings rise, suggesting systemic risk
articles.summary: NBFCs' rising dependence on bank borrowings needs monitoring for systemic risks, according to an RBI study. Diversification of funding is imperative, as bank borrowings formed 39.6% of total NBFC borrowings in FY26.

articles.headline: Flipkart CEO steps down after over 11 years amid IPO limbo
articles.summary: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy will step down after 11 years. Reasons cited include IPO delay, Esop liquidity issues, and financial performance concerns.

articles.headline: Auto PLI scheme disbursement up 120% to ~2.6K cr in FY27
articles.summary: Ministry of Heavy Industries disbursed ~4,385.28 crore under the auto PLI scheme in FY27, more than double the ~2,064.36 crore in FY26, promoting investments and supply chains.

articles.headline: Jindal Steel targets ~15,000 cr investment by 2035 using internal accruals
articles.summary: Jindal Steel plans to invest ~15,000 crore by 2035 in Odisha and Chhattisgarh plants, using an 'earn and invest' approach from internal savings instead of bank loans.

articles.headline: Italian bag brand Carpisa eyes 100 stores in India over 10 yrs
articles.summary: Italian handbag and luggage brand Carpisa targets 100 stores and ~500 crore revenue in India over 10 years, betting on the growing middle class and organised retail market.

articles.headline: Economy resilient; central bank brings home 60 tonnes gold in H1FY27
articles.summary: India's economy showed resilience in October, supported by strong credit growth and exports. The RBI brought 60.08 tonnes of gold domestically, increasing domestic holdings to 84%.

articles.headline: Net FDI at negative $4.9 billion in Sep; RBI bought $6.94 billion in Sep
articles.summary: Net FDI swung to an outflow of $4.9 billion in September, while the RBI net purchased $6.94 billion in September, marking its fourth consecutive month of net buying.

articles.headline: GIFT City insurance premiums topped $1 billion in H1FY27: IFSCA chairman
articles.summary: Insurance premiums reported by IIOs at GIFT City crossed $1 billion in H1FY27, with Q2 business surging nearly 10-fold YoY, driven by technology and AI innovation.

articles.headline: Service PPI inflation rose in Q2FY27
articles.summary: Price growth in seven services sectors rose in Q2FY27, with air passenger services seeing the highest inflation at 35.52% YoY. Banking and securities transactions remained in deflation.

articles.headline: Microsoft declares ‘Code Red’ after global outage exposes crisis response gaps
articles.summary: Microsoft declared a 'Code Red' to overhaul its crisis response after a 24-hour outage disrupted Exchange Online and other services, exposing significant engineering and operational weaknesses.

articles.headline: Houthis say they attacked Saudi Arabia’s Ras Tanura refinery
articles.summary: Yemen's Houthi group claimed responsibility for attacking Saudi Arabia's Ras Tanura oil refinery, stating it caused fires. The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted drones.

articles.headline: AI stocks slide on fears over infrastructure buildout costs
articles.summary: AI-linked stocks slid significantly as investors weighed soaring infrastructure costs against uncertain returns. Chipmakers and server providers experienced heavy selling.

articles.headline: PhonePe warms up for IPO as investor appetite returns
articles.summary: Walmart-owned PhonePe is preparing to restart its IPO process, aiming for a listing valuation between ~1.2 to ~1.5 trillion, after a period of muted growth and weak macro conditions.

articles.headline: No violation of AI scheme in Sarvam’s Chinese offerings, says Meity Secretary
articles.summary: Meity Secretary S Krishnan stated that Sarvam AI hosting Chinese AI models does not violate India AI Mission principles, as it's an open-source offering. India is developing its own frontier AI model.

articles.headline: Open-source models to become more prevalent going forward: GitHub CEO
articles.summary: GitHub CEO Thomas Dohmke predicts open-source AI models will become more prevalent due to economic pressure and improving quality, offering a viable substitute for many tasks.

articles.headline: Built in US, founded by Indians, startups bought for billions
articles.summary: Indian-origin entrepreneurs' startups like Zscaler and Cursor are being acquired for billions, marking a third wave of success where product businesses are sold at high valuations.

articles.headline: Prosus portfolio firms push PayU’s payments by 80%
articles.summary: Prosus' India portfolio saw payments processed by PayU grow over 80% YoY in H1FY27, with adjusted Ebitda turning positive at $12 million, driven by higher-margin services.

articles.headline: A growing web of EU rules on sustainability, traceability, and human rights
articles.summary: New EU regulations on deforestation, green claims, and human rights will impact Indian exports, requiring detailed data and compliance, potentially increasing costs for exporters.

articles.headline: Digital-fraud prevention needs institutional accountability
articles.summary: RBI's draft amendments for digital payments aim to prevent fraud by giving customers more control, but banks must invest in real-time detection and swift action to ensure accountability.
